svg.text: F2: Gimbal Lock Singularity vs Rotation Vector
svg.title: F2: Gimbal Lock Singularity vs Rotation Vector
svg.desc: model_scenario: Demonstration of Euler gimbal lock near 90 degrees pitch causing indeterminate yaw/roll difference, contrasted with the rotation vector remaining smooth. Labelled model_scenario.
svg.text: Euler Cardan (ZYX): Gimbal lock detected (roll/yaw indeterminate)
Trade-off: coordinate singularities vs parameter redundancy. Neither is universally correct.
